en.content: A light disc made of aluminium (a nonmagnetic material) is kept horizontally and is free to rotate about its axis as shown in the figure. A strong magnet is held vertically at a point above the disc away from its axis. On revolving the magnet about the axis of the disc, the disc will (figure is schematic and not drawn to scale)

options.content: rotate in the direction opposite to the direction of magnet’s motion
rotate in the same direction as the direction of magnet’s motion
not rotate and its temperature will remain unchanged
not rotate but its temperature will slowly rise

en.explanation: When the magnet is moved, it creates a state, where the plate moves through the magnetic flux, due to which an electromotive force is generated in the plate and eddy currents are induced. These currents are such that it opposes the relative motion <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.054ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.262ex" height="1.242ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -525 1000 549" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="21D2" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-21D2"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> disc will rotate in the direction of rotation of magnet.

hi.content: एलुमिनियम (एक अचुम्बकीय पदार्थ) से बनी एक हल्की चक्रिका (disc) क्षैतिज अवस्था में रखी है एवं यह अपने अक्ष (axis) के परितः घूर्णन करने के लिए स्वतंत्र है, जैसा कि नीचे चित्र में दिखाया गया है। यदि एक प्रबल चुम्बक को चक्रिका से थोड़ा ऊपर, उसके अक्ष से दूर एक बिंदु पर ऊर्ध्वाधर अवस्था में रखते हुए चक्रिका के अक्ष के परितः परिक्रमण (revolve) कराया जाय तब चक्रिका [चित्र प्रतीकात्मक (schematic) हैं तथा माप के अनुसार नहीं है ]
